integrity: Exact-recurrence local proof and standalone standard-library verification; finite checks are diagnostic, not the infinite proof. Prior Korselt characterization explicitly acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Admissibility and Korselt implication are unconditional; infinitude of simultaneous prime values assumes Dickson’s conjecture. No asymptotic or unconditional infinite prime-tuple result. Possible unindexed earlier results.
title: Uniform local admissibility of Lucas-balancing Carmichael prime triples
